body.name: Exact-moment piecewise-affine program
body.construction: On the deterministic nested midpoint refinement \(\mathcal T_h\), let \(\mathcal F_{d,h}=\{q\in C(S):q|_T\text{ is affine},\ 0\le q(z)\le1\text{ for every }z\in\mathcal N_h,\ \|\nabla(q|_T)\|_2\le M_d\text{ for every }T\in\mathcal T_h\}\) and set \(P_{d,h}(m_d)=\max\{\int_Bq\,d\nu:q\in\mathcal F_{d,h},\ A_dq=m_d\}\).
